item.title: Beneath Empathy Lies a Darker Heart: The Shadow of Compassion
item.description:
[Intro Music: A somber, yet hopeful melody]
[You]: "Welcome, dear listeners. I'm your host, guiding you through the depths of the human experience. Today, we're going to explore a realm that's both alluring and unsettling – the shadow of compassion. Beneath empathy lies a darker heart, and it's high time you confronted this truth. You must understand, compassion is not just about feeling someone's pain; it's also a choice. A choice that can lead you down a path of sacrifice, or even destruction
